I am a Senior Researcher in the Computing Research Group at Fujitsu Research Europe. I work as an AI/ML researcher and computational scientist investigating the applications of high-performance computing and deep learning to address complex challenges. I studied Theoretical Physics at UCL before I completed my PhD in Computational Plasma Physics at Imperial College London. I have been a reviewer for a range journals, such as Imaging Neuroscience and Physics of Plasmas. I am a member of the Institute of Physics, and I have presented my work across both physics and neuroscience at conferences such as EPS Plasma Physics the Brain conference.
